name: Prediction Filter
description: Filters candidate conditions through model predictions. Applies a custom filter function to predicted outcomes and returns only those conditions meeting specified criteria.

prediction_filter.name: filter_function
prediction_filter.description: Callable that evaluates model predictions and returns boolean values indicating which conditions to keep.

variables.name: conditions
variables.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to filter.

variables.name: model
variables.description: Sklearn-compatible estimator with a predict method to generate predictions for filtering.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Filtered experimental conditions whose model predictions satisfy the filter function criteria.
